scope: Complete HBQ damageInit, protectBriefly and initVehicle helpers; not whole-HBQ parity

findings.evidence: damageInit applies current damage for events with empty ammo, null instigator, speed below20km/h, eligible feature and living AI driver. It leaves other events without an override. It does not read the source argument. Jitter counting precedes feature/driver checks and counts HandleDamage invocations, not proven unique physical collisions.
findings.disposition: Retain damage-category discrimination and jitter escape intent. CBE currently has no general vehicle collision-damage filter; parachute exit protection is not equivalent. Do not import broad invulnerability or claim weapons/other-mod handler compatibility from this predicate alone.

findings.evidence: protectBriefly captures vehicle/crew permissions, applies false, then restores captured true permissions after a scheduled sleep. A second overlapping capture observes false while the first timer may enable damage before the second interval ends. Delayed restoration has no token/current-owner or newer-controller proof.
findings.disposition: Reject independent baseline/timer restoration. Future CBE protection needs exact current-owner receipt and coordinated overlapping-owner semantics. Same-value external false writes remain unobservable without cooperation. No repair/teleport/recreate protection imported.

findings.evidence: initVehicle excludes static weapons, coalesces local initialization, waits5s, checks enabled, installs damage and native Local handlers, and starts current-local driving. The complete runtime settings/reenablement callgraph was not re-established in this scoped review.
findings.disposition: Retain dynamic object/locality intent. Do not infer whole-addon enable/disable behaviour from this helper alone; CBE owner-local lifetime and cleanup require separate validation.

findings.evidence: CortexParachuteJump previously accepted matching supplied object without proving Air/non-parachute class and performed admission before exit geometry work.
findings.disposition: Added real-airframe and simulation/visibility checks plus unscheduled actor authority recheck before damage baseline capture and exit mutation. This does not fix existing delayed damage overlap or mid-exit migration.

nextWork: Design exact current-owner protection release before replacing bare allowDamage remote callbacks.
Persist and adopt the actual in-progress exit phase on locality change without replaying seat/velocity mutations.
Physically test invalid context, direct/queued admission, failed exit/boarding, overlap, preexisting invulnerability and migration once audits resume.
